Next week, Apple will unveil the iPhone Ultra at its September event, and today Tom's Guide's exclusive interview with Mark Gurman has revealed multiple details ahead of time, including specifications, software, and launch timing.

Below is the information about the iPhone Ultra revealed by Mark Gurman

There's still a week until the iPhone Ultra debut, but new leaks keep emerging. In an interview with Tom's Guide today, Mark Gurman shared quite a bit of new information, including some previously unheard-of details.

For example, MagSafe has always been a question mark for the iPhone Ultra, but Gurman quickly clarified that MagSafe has not been cancelled: "MagSafe is still there. Based on everything I've heard, this foldable will have MagSafe."

When discussing the iPhone Ultra's specifications, Gurman mentioned:

  • 5.5-inch outer display, 7.8-inch inner display
  • Equipped with the latest Apple Pro chip and the latest Apple modem

He also discussed two key features: the rumoured "crease-free" display and a liquid metal hinge. He noted that the crease hasn't actually disappeared entirely, but the effect is comparable to the new generation of Samsung foldables, and may even be superior thanks to a more durable hinge.

Multitasking was another key topic in the interview. Gurman had previously reported that iOS 27 would support iPad-like app layouts and side-by-side multitasking, and today he further indicated that drag-and-drop functionality will be supported between multiple apps, making it easier for users to quickly transfer data between different apps.
